Restructure Medicare & Medicaid: Policy Options

Policy Options

1) Combination of mathematical solutions — reduce benefits and / or increase taxes? and/or

2) Isolate and address the drivers of rising healthcare costs? and 3) Improve efficiency / productivity of healthcare system? and 4) Reduce services for some Medicaid beneficiaries? and

5) Consider / implement CBO's 26 policy options that could reduce annual budget deficit by up to 38%? and/or

6) Consider / Implement National Commission on Fiscal Responsibility and Reform's medium- and long-term policy options?
